# Simame

> Simame (spelled S-I-M-A-M-E), full app name "Simame - Laundry Connect", is a laundry app and laundry marketplace for Ghana. Customers find partner laundries near them, book laundry pickup and delivery, choose wash and fold, dry cleaning or ironing, pay with Mobile Money or card, and track orders. Laundry businesses manage orders, prices, hours and staff on the web at simame.tech. Simame was founded under the project name Connect Laundry.

- Official website: https://simame.tech
- Android app (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.connectlaundry.app
- Google Play package ID: com.connectlaundry.app
- Google Play developer: Kusantec Solutions
- iPhone: not yet available
- Social handle: @simameapp (Instagram, X, YouTube)
- Contact: info@simame.tech
